findings.issue: The agent installed a full unit-test stack (vitest, jsdom, '@angular/build:unit-test' builder, 'ng test' script) but wrote zero spec files, leaving the app with no regression protection of its own.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for the pure helpers (util.ts) and resolver/table-building logic; these need no Angular TestBed and would cover most of the risk cheaply.

findings.issue: URL-driven filtering and pagination (q/type/generation matching against humanized names, 48-per-page slicing, page clamping via Number.parseInt and Math.min) is completely untested; parseInt even accepts '?page=3abc' as 3.
findings.suggestion: Test the filtered/currentPage/pageEntries computeds against a small fixture species list: empty filters, one matching species, page beyond total, non-numeric page.

findings.issue: sortedRows implements the spec's trickiest rules — missing values last in both directions, direction flip, tie-break by level-then-name, aria-sort — with no tests; a subtle refactor (e.g. multiplying the null checks by dir) would silently break sorting.
findings.suggestion: Extract or test sortedRows directly with rows containing null power/accuracy and assert order and ariaSort() output for asc/desc on every column.

findings.issue: cardsFor hides the highest-bug-density logic: alternate-form exclusion (id > 10000), the deoxys-normal→species fallback that issues one extra API call per unmapped Pokémon, dedup by speciesId, and note lookup keyed by Pokémon (not species) name — all untested.
findings.suggestion: Test with refs including deoxys-normal, a Mega form (id 10033) and a duplicate: assert exclusion, species mapping, dedup and dex-number ordering.

findings.issue: Bare catch blocks (also move.resolver.ts:46, ability.resolver.ts:44, type.resolver.ts) render API 500s and network failures as a 404 'Not found' page with a 404 response status, masking outages as missing resources; no test pins this.
findings.suggestion: Add resolver tests distinguishing HTTP 404 from other failures, and consider surfacing a retryable error state instead of 'Not found' for non-404 failures.

findings.issue: buildMoveTables' dedup key (name|method|level), METHOD_ORDER ranking with alphabetical fallback for other methods, and default ordering rules are untested; a change to the key or rank silently duplicates rows or reorders tables.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test buildMoveTables with a fixture Pokémon covering level-up, machine, egg and an unranked method, asserting table order and row order.

findings.issue: The in-memory cache's URL construction (trailing slash vs '?' handling) and failed-request eviction are untested; a regression could cache a rejected promise forever or collide cache keys for 'pokemon/25' and 'pokemon-species/25'.
findings.suggestion: Test get() with a stubbed HttpClient: dedup of concurrent identical requests, eviction after rejection, and URL normalization for paths with and without query strings.

findings.issue: Pure helpers (humanize, idFromUrl, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor, orDash) back every page's text yet have no tests; whitespace-collapse or zero-padding regressions would appear across the whole app.
findings.suggestion: A five-case unit file for util.ts is the cheapest high-value test in the codebase.

findings.issue: onSearch pushes a router.navigate on every keystroke with no debounce, so each typed character likely adds a history entry; the back-button experience is untested and would regress invisibly.
findings.suggestion: Debounce to ~300ms (allowed by the spec) and add a test that typing a multi-character query results in one URL/history update.

findings.issue: The search-box/URL sync effect (lastRequestedSearch vs searchText comparison) handles back/forward navigation with no coverage; desync between the input and ?q= after history navigation would slip through.
findings.suggestion: A component test that navigates back/forward with different q values and asserts the input value mirrors the URL.

summary: The agent scaffolded a complete unit-test setup (vitest, jsdom, unit-test builder) but wrote no tests of its own — every behavioral guarantee rests on the acceptance suite. The untested surface includes exactly the code most likely to break under refactoring: URL-driven filtering/pagination, move-table sorting with missing-values-last, alt-form→species mapping, and resolver error handling that reports API failures as 404s. The silver lining is that most of this risk sits in pure functions and computeds that would be cheap to test now.

untested.area: util.ts pure helpers (humanize, idFromUrl, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor whitespace collapse, orDash)
untested.likelyBug: A tweak to whitespace collapsing or zero-padding breaks displayed dex numbers, flavor text and humanized names on every page at once.

untested.area: Home filtering, pagination and URL query state (q/type/generation/page)
untested.likelyBug: Filter stops matching (e.g. type-name key mismatch), page slice is off by one showing wrong 48 cards, or ?page=999/negative/non-numeric values render an empty list instead of clamping to a valid page.

untested.area: Move-table column sorting (missing-values-last in both directions, tie-breaks, aria-sort)
untested.likelyBug: Null power/accuracy sort first after a refactor, or a second click no longer flips direction, or aria-sort stays on the wrong header — silent to every non-acceptance check.

untested.area: cardsFor species mapping: alt-form exclusion, deoxys-normal fallback, dedup, hidden-ability notes
untested.likelyBug: Mega forms (id > 10000) leak into 'Learned by' lists, deoxys-normal renders as its own duplicate card, or the 'Hidden ability' note attaches to the wrong Pokémon.

untested.area: Resolver error paths (catch → 404 page and status)
untested.likelyBug: An API 500 or timeout renders as 'Not found' with a 404 status, hiding outages from users and monitoring.

untested.area: buildMoveTables: method table ordering, dedup key, default game selection (highest order)
untested.likelyBug: Tables reorder (Egg before Machine), a move appears twice in one table, or the wrong version group is selected by default.

untested.area: Api in-memory cache: key normalization and failed-request eviction
untested.likelyBug: A rejected promise gets cached forever so a transient API blip permanently breaks a resource, or 'pokemon/25' and other same-suffixed paths collide.

untested.area: Search input ↔ URL sync on back/forward navigation and history pollution from per-keystroke navigate
untested.likelyBug: The search box desyncs from ?q= after history navigation, or each typed character creates a history entry making the back button step through every character.

untested.area: SSR response status via RESPONSE_INIT and Title service per route
untested.likelyBug: Invalid routes stop returning 404 status, or the document title regresses to 'Pokédex' on detail pages, without any test noticing.
